description: This Kotlin source file defines the TracksFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying and managing a list of user-selected music tracks within the app. The fragment handles UI initialization, loading tracks from a local library, importing tracks via URIs, and providing actions to load tracks into specific deck slots for mixing.

classes.name: TracksFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of tracks, handles importing URIs, and provides actions for loading tracks into decks.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the local library instance when the fragment attaches to the context.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up a result listener for incoming URI additions.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up the RecyclerView adapter and layout manager, and loads existing tracks.

methods.name: importUris
methods.description: Imports tracks from a list of URIs, updating the local library and UI accordingly.

methods.name: onAddToDeckA
methods.description: Handles loading a track into deck A by sending a result to the parent fragment.

methods.name: onAddToDeckB
methods.description: Handles loading a track into deck B by sending a result to the parent fragment.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes a track from the library and updates the UI.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies UI component references when the view is destroyed to prevent memory leaks.
